051/**
052 * Used to perform constraint validation over one or more node items.
053 * <p>
054 * This class is not thread safe.
055 */
056@SuppressWarnings({
057    "PMD.CouplingBetweenObjects",
058    "PMD.GodClass" // provides validators for all types
059})
060public class DefaultConstraintValidator
061    implements IConstraintValidator, IMutableConfiguration<ValidationFeature<?>> { // NOPMD - intentional
062  private static final Logger LOGGER = LogManager.getLogger(DefaultConstraintValidator.class);
063
064  @NonNull
065  private final Map<INodeItem, ValueStatus> valueMap = new LinkedHashMap<>(); // NOPMD - intentional
066  @NonNull
067  private final Map<String, IIndex> indexNameToIndexMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
068  @NonNull
069  private final Map<String, List<KeyRef>> indexNameToKeyRefMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
070  @NonNull
071  private final IConstraintValidationHandler handler;
072  @NonNull
073  private final IMutableConfiguration<ValidationFeature<?>> configuration;
074

140  @Override
141  public void validate(
142      @NonNull INodeItem item,
143      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
144    try {
145      item.accept(new Visitor(), dynamicContext);
146    } catch (WrappedException ex) {
147      ex.unwrapAndThrow(ConstraintValidationException.class);
148    }
149  }
150
151  /**
152   * Validate the provided flag item against any associated constraints.
153   *
154   * @param item
155   *          the flag item to validate
156   * @param dynamicContext
157   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
158   *          evaluation
159   * @throws MetapathException
160   *           if an error occurred while evaluating a Metapath used in a
161   *           constraint
162   */
163  protected void validateFlag(
164      @NonNull IFlagNodeItem item,
165      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
166    IFlagDefinition definition = item.getDefinition();
167
168    try {
169      validateExpect(definition.getExpectConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
170      validateAllowedValues(definition.getAllowedValuesConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
171      validateIndexHasKey(definition.getIndexHasKeyConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
172      validateMatches(definition.getMatchesConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
173    } catch (ConstraintValidationException ex) {
174      throw ExceptionUtils.wrap(ex);
175    }
176  }

205  /**
206   * Validate the provided assembly item against any associated constraints.

214   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
215   */
216  protected void validateAssembly(
217      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item,
218      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
219    IAssemblyDefinition definition = item.getDefinition();
220
221    try {
222      validateExpect(definition.getExpectConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
223      validateAllowedValues(definition.getAllowedValuesConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
224      validateIndexHasKey(definition.getIndexHasKeyConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
225      validateMatches(definition.getMatchesConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
226      validateHasCardinality(definition.getHasCardinalityConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
227      validateIndex(definition.getIndexConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
228      validateUnique(definition.getUniqueConstraints(), item, dynamicContext);
229    } catch (ConstraintValidationException ex) {
230      throw ExceptionUtils.wrap(ex);
231    }
232  }

234  /**
235   * Evaluates the provided collection of {@code constraints} in the context of
236   * the {@code item}.
237   *
238   * @param constraints
239   *          the constraints to execute
240   * @param item
241   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation
242   * @param dynamicContext
243   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
244   *          evaluation
245   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
246   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
247   */
248  private void validateHasCardinality( // NOPMD false positive
249      @NonNull List<? extends ICardinalityConstraint> constraints,
250      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item,
251      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
252    for (ICardinalityConstraint constraint : constraints) {
253      assert constraint != null;
254      try {
255        ISequence<? extends IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> targets = constraint.matchTargets(item, dynamicContext);
256        validateHasCardinality(constraint, item, targets, dynamicContext);
257      } catch (MetapathException ex) {
258        handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
259      }
260    }
261  }
262
263  /**
264   * Evaluates the provided {@code constraint} against each of the
265   * {@code targets}.
266   *
267   * @param constraint
268   *          the constraint to execute
269   * @param node
270   *          the original focus of Metapath evaluation for identifying the
271   *          targets
272   * @param targets
273   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation for evaluating any constraint
274   *          Metapath clauses
275   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
276   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
277   */
278  private void validateHasCardinality(
279      @NonNull ICardinalityConstraint constraint,
280      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem node,
281      @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> targets,
282      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
283    int itemCount = targets.size();
284
285    IConstraintValidationHandler handler = getConstraintValidationHandler();
286
287    boolean violation = false;
288    Integer minOccurs = constraint.getMinOccurs();
289    if (minOccurs != null && itemCount < minOccurs) {
290      handler.handleCardinalityMinimumViolation(constraint, node, targets, dynamicContext);
291      violation = true;
292    }
293
294    Integer maxOccurs = constraint.getMaxOccurs();
295    if (maxOccurs != null && itemCount > maxOccurs) {
296      handler.handleCardinalityMaximumViolation(constraint, node, targets, dynamicContext);
297      violation = true;
298    }
299
300    if (!violation) {
301      handlePass(constraint, node, node, dynamicContext);
302    }
303  }
304
305  /**
306   * Evaluates the provided collection of {@code constraints} in the context of
307   * the {@code item}.
308   *
309   * @param constraints
310   *          the constraints to execute
311   * @param item
312   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation
313   * @param dynamicContext
314   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
315   *          evaluation
316   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
317   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
318   */
319  private void validateIndex(
320      @NonNull List<? extends IIndexConstraint> constraints,
321      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item,
322      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
323    for (IIndexConstraint constraint : constraints) {
324      assert constraint != null;
325
326      try {
327        ISequence<? extends IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> targets = constraint.matchTargets(item, dynamicContext);
328        validateIndex(constraint, item, targets, dynamicContext);
329      } catch (MetapathException ex) {
330        handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
331      }
332    }
333  }
334
335  /**
336   * Evaluates the provided {@code constraint} against each of the
337   * {@code targets}.
338   *
339   * @param constraint
340   *          the constraint to execute
341   * @param node
342   *          the original focus of Metapath evaluation for identifying the
343   *          targets
344   * @param targets
345   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation for evaluating any constraint
346   *          Metapath clauses
347   * @param dynamicContext
348   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
349   *          evaluation
350   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
351   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
352   */
353  private void validateIndex(
354      @NonNull IIndexConstraint constraint,
355      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem node,
356      @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> targets,
357      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
358    IConstraintValidationHandler handler = getConstraintValidationHandler();
359    if (indexNameToIndexMap.containsKey(constraint.getName())) {
360      handler.handleIndexDuplicateViolation(constraint, node, dynamicContext);
361    } else {
362      validateIndexEntries(constraint, node, targets, dynamicContext);
363    }
364  }
365
366  private void validateIndexEntries(
367      @NonNull IIndexConstraint constraint,
368      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem node,
369      @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> targets,
370      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
371    IIndex index = IIndex.newInstance(constraint.getKeyFields());
372    for (INodeItem item : targets) {
373      assert item != null;
374      if (item.hasValue()) {
375        INodeItem oldItem = null;
376        try {
377          oldItem = index.put(item, IIndex.toKey(item, index.getKeyFields(), dynamicContext));
378        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
379          // throw by IIndex.toKey
380          handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
381        }
382        try {
383          if (oldItem == null) {
384            handlePass(constraint, node, item, dynamicContext);
385          } else {
386            handler.handleIndexDuplicateKeyViolation(constraint, node, oldItem, item, dynamicContext);
387          }
388        } catch (MetapathException ex) {
389          handler.handleKeyMatchError(constraint, node, item, ex, dynamicContext);
390        }
391      }
392    }
393    indexNameToIndexMap.put(constraint.getName(), index);
394  }
395
396  private void handlePass(
397      @NonNull IConstraint constraint,
398      @NonNull INodeItem node,
399      @NonNull INodeItem item,
400      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
401    if (isFeatureEnabled(ValidationFeature.VALIDATE_GENERATE_PASS_FINDINGS)) {
402      getConstraintValidationHandler().handlePass(constraint, node, item, dynamicContext);
403    }
404  }
405
406  private void handleError(
407      @NonNull IConstraint constraint,
408      @NonNull INodeItem node,
409      @NonNull Throwable ex,
410      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
411    if (isFeatureEnabled(ValidationFeature.THROW_EXCEPTION_ON_ERROR)) {
412      if (ex instanceof ConstraintValidationException) {
413        throw (ConstraintValidationException) ex;
414      }
415      throw new ConstraintValidationException(ex);
416    }
417    getConstraintValidationHandler()
418        .handleError(constraint, node, toErrorMessage(constraint, node, ex), ex, dynamicContext);
419  }
420
421  @NonNull
422  private static String toErrorMessage(
423      @NonNull IConstraint constraint,
424      @NonNull INodeItem item,
425      @NonNull Throwable ex) {
426    StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(128);
427    builder.append("A ")
428        .append(constraint.getType().getName())
429        .append(" constraint");
430
431    String id = constraint.getId();
432    if (id == null) {
433      builder.append(" targeting the metapath '")
434          .append(constraint.getTarget().getPath())
435          .append('\'');
436    } else {
437      builder.append(" with id '")
438          .append(id)
439          .append('\'');
440    }
441
442    builder.append(", matching the item at path '")
443        .append(item.getMetapath())
444        .append("', resulted in an unexpected error. ")
445        .append(ex.getLocalizedMessage());
446    return ObjectUtils.notNull(builder.toString());
447  }

449  /**
450   * Evaluates the provided collection of {@code constraints} in the context of
451   * the {@code item}.
452   *
453   * @param constraints
454   *          the constraints to execute
455   * @param item
456   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation
457   * @param dynamicContext
458   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
459   *          evaluation
460   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
461   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
462   */
463  private void validateUnique(
464      @NonNull List<? extends IUniqueConstraint> constraints,
465      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item,
466      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
467    for (IUniqueConstraint constraint : constraints) {
468      assert constraint != null;
469
470      try {
471        ISequence<? extends IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> targets = constraint.matchTargets(item, dynamicContext);
472        validateUnique(constraint, item, targets, dynamicContext);
473      } catch (MetapathException ex) {
474        handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
475      }
476    }
477  }

479  /**
480   * Evaluates the provided {@code constraint} against each of the
481   * {@code targets}.
482   *
483   * @param constraint
484   *          the constraint to execute
485   * @param node
486   *          the original focus of Metapath evaluation for identifying the
487   *          targets
488   * @param targets
489   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation for evaluating any constraint
490   *          Metapath clauses
491   * @param dynamicContext
492   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
493   *          evaluation
494   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
495   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
496   */
497  private void validateUnique(
498      @NonNull IUniqueConstraint constraint,
499      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem node,
500      @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> targets,
501      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
502
503    IConstraintValidationHandler handler = getConstraintValidationHandler();
504    IIndex index = IIndex.newInstance(constraint.getKeyFields());
505
506    for (INodeItem item : targets) {
507      assert item != null;
508      if (item.hasValue()) {
509        INodeItem oldItem = null;
510        try {
511          oldItem = index.put(item, IIndex.toKey(item, index.getKeyFields(), dynamicContext));
512        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
513          // raised by IIndex.toKey
514          handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
515        }
516
517        try {
518          if (oldItem == null) {
519            handlePass(constraint, node, item, dynamicContext);
520          } else {
521            handler.handleUniqueKeyViolation(constraint, node, oldItem, item, dynamicContext);
522          }
523        } catch (MetapathException ex) {
524          handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
525        }
526      }
527    }
528  }

540   *          evaluation
541   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
542   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
543   */

545      @NonNull List<? extends IMatchesConstraint> constraints,
546      @NonNull IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?> item,
547      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
548
549    for (IMatchesConstraint constraint : constraints) {
550      assert constraint != null;
551
552      try {
553        ISequence<? extends IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> targets = constraint.matchTargets(item, dynamicContext);
554        validateMatches(constraint, item, targets, dynamicContext);
555      } catch (MetapathException ex) {
556        handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);

561  /**
562   * Evaluates the provided {@code constraint} against each of the
563   * {@code targets}.
564   *
565   * @param constraint
566   *          the constraint to execute
567   * @param node
568   *          the original focus of Metapath evaluation for identifying the
569   *          targets
570   * @param targets
571   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation for evaluating any constraint
572   *          Metapath clauses
573   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
574   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
575   */
576  private void validateMatches(
577      @NonNull IMatchesConstraint constraint,
578      @NonNull INodeItem node,
579      @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> targets,
580      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
581    for (INodeItem item : targets) {
582      assert item != null;
583      if (item.hasValue()) {
584        validateMatchesItem(constraint, node, item, dynamicContext);
585      }
586    }
587  }
588
589  private void validateMatchesItem(
590      @NonNull IMatchesConstraint constraint,
591      @NonNull INodeItem node,
592      @NonNull INodeItem item,
593      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
594    String value = item.toAtomicItem().asString();
595
596    IConstraintValidationHandler handler = getConstraintValidationHandler();
597    boolean valid = true;
598    Pattern pattern = constraint.getPattern();
599    if (pattern != null && !pattern.asMatchPredicate().test(value)) {
600      // failed pattern match
601      handler.handleMatchPatternViolation(constraint, node, item, value, pattern, dynamicContext);
602      valid = false;
603    }
604
605    IDataTypeAdapter<?> adapter = constraint.getDataType();
606    if (adapter != null) {
607      try {
608        adapter.parse(value);
609      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
610        handler.handleMatchDatatypeViolation(constraint, node, item, value, adapter, ex, dynamicContext);
611        valid = false;
612      }
613    }
614
615    if (valid) {
616      handlePass(constraint, node, item, dynamicContext);
617    }
618  }

651  /**
652   * Evaluates the provided {@code constraint} against each of the
653   * {@code targets}.
654   *
655   * @param constraint
656   *          the constraint to execute
657   * @param node
658   *          the original focus of Metapath evaluation for identifying the
659   *          targets
660   * @param targets
661   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation for evaluating any constraint
662   *          Metapath clauses
663   */
664  private void validateIndexHasKey(
665      @NonNull IIndexHasKeyConstraint constraint,
666      @NonNull IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?> node,
667      @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> targets) {
668    String indexName = constraint.getIndexName();
669
670    List<KeyRef> keyRefItems = indexNameToKeyRefMap.get(indexName);
671    if (keyRefItems == null) {
672      keyRefItems = new LinkedList<>();
673      indexNameToKeyRefMap.put(indexName, keyRefItems);
674    }
675
676    keyRefItems.add(new KeyRef(constraint, node, new ArrayList<>(targets)));
677  }

708
709  /**
710   * Evaluates the provided {@code constraint} against each of the
711   * {@code targets}.
712   *
713   * @param constraint
714   *          the constraint to execute
715   * @param node
716   *          the original focus of Metapath evaluation for identifying the
717   *          targets
718   * @param targets
719   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation for evaluating any constraint
720   *          Metapath clauses
721   * @param dynamicContext
722   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
723   *          evaluation
724   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
725   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
726   */
727  private void validateExpect(
728      @NonNull IExpectConstraint constraint,
729      @NonNull INodeItem node,
730      @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> targets,
731      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
732    IMetapathExpression test = constraint.getTest();
733    IConstraintValidationHandler handler = getConstraintValidationHandler();
734    for (INodeItem item : targets) {
735      assert item != null;
736
737      if (item.hasValue()) {
738        try {
739          ISequence<?> result = test.evaluate(item, dynamicContext);
740          if (FnBoolean.fnBoolean(result).toBoolean()) {
741            handlePass(constraint, node, item, dynamicContext);
742          } else {
743            handler.handleExpectViolation(constraint, node, item, dynamicContext);
744          }
745        } catch (MetapathException ex) {
746          handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
747        }
748      }
749    }
750  }
751
752  /**
753   * Evaluates the provided collection of {@code constraints} in the context of
754   * the {@code item}.
755   *
756   * @param constraints
757   *          the constraints to execute
758   * @param item
759   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation
760   * @param dynamicContext
761   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
762   *          evaluation
763   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
764   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
765   */
766  private void validateAllowedValues(
767      @NonNull List<? extends IAllowedValuesConstraint> constraints,
768      @NonNull IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?> item,
769      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
770    for (IAllowedValuesConstraint constraint : constraints) {
771      assert constraint != null;
772      try {
773        ISequence<? extends IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> targets = constraint.matchTargets(item, dynamicContext);
774        validateAllowedValues(constraint, item, targets, dynamicContext);
775      } catch (MetapathException ex) {
776        handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
777      }
778    }
779  }
780
781  /**
782   * Evaluates the provided {@code constraint} against each of the
783   * {@code targets}.
784   *
785   * @param constraint
786   *          the constraint to execute
787   * @param node
788   *          the original focus of Metapath evaluation for identifying the
789   *          targets
790   * @param targets
791   *          the focus of Metapath evaluation for evaluating any constraint
792   *          Metapath clauses
793   * @param dynamicContext
794   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
795   *          evaluation
796   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
797   *           if an unexpected error occurred while validating a constraint
798   */
799  private void validateAllowedValues(
800      @NonNull IAllowedValuesConstraint constraint,
801      @NonNull IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?> node,
802      @NonNull ISequence<? extends IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> targets,
803      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
804    for (INodeItem item : targets) {
805      assert item != null;
806      if (item.hasValue()) {
807        try {
808          updateValueStatus(item, constraint, node);
809        } catch (ConstraintValidationException ex) {
810          handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
811        }
812      }
813    }
814  }
815
816  /**
817   * Add a new allowed value to the value status tracker.
818   *
819   * @param targetItem
820   *          the item whose value is targeted by the constraint
821   * @param allowedValues
822   *          the allowed values constraint
823   * @param node
824   *          the original focus of Metapath evaluation for identifying the
825   *          targets
826   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
827   *           if an unexpected error occurred while registering the allowed
828   *           values
829   */
830  protected void updateValueStatus(
831      @NonNull INodeItem targetItem,
832      @NonNull IAllowedValuesConstraint allowedValues,
833      @NonNull IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?> node) throws ConstraintValidationException {
834    // constraint.getAllowedValues().containsKey(value)
835
836    @Nullable
837    ValueStatus valueStatus = valueMap.get(targetItem);
838    if (valueStatus == null) {
839      valueStatus = new ValueStatus(targetItem);
840      valueMap.put(targetItem, valueStatus);
841    }
842
843    valueStatus.registerAllowedValues(allowedValues, node);
844  }
845
846  /**
847   * Evaluate the value associated with the {@code targetItem} and update the
848   * status tracker.
849   *
850   * @param targetItem
851   *          the item whose value will be validated
852   * @param dynamicContext
853   *          the Metapath dynamic execution context to use for Metapath
854   *          evaluation
855   */
856  protected void handleAllowedValues(
857      @NonNull INodeItem targetItem,
858      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
859    ValueStatus valueStatus = valueMap.remove(targetItem);
860    if (valueStatus != null) {
861      valueStatus.validate(dynamicContext);
862    }
863  }
864
865  @Override
866  public void finalizeValidation(DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
867    // key references
868    for (Map.Entry<String, List<KeyRef>> entry : indexNameToKeyRefMap.entrySet()) {
869      String indexName = ObjectUtils.notNull(entry.getKey());
870      IIndex index = indexNameToIndexMap.get(indexName);
871
872      List<KeyRef> keyRefs = entry.getValue();
873
874      for (KeyRef keyRef : keyRefs) {
875        IIndexHasKeyConstraint constraint = keyRef.getConstraint();
876
877        INodeItem node = keyRef.getNode();
878        List<INodeItem> targets = keyRef.getTargets();
879        for (INodeItem item : targets) {
880          assert item != null;
881          try {
882            validateKeyRef(constraint, node, item, indexName, index, dynamicContext);
883          } catch (MetapathException ex) {
884            handleError(constraint, item, ex, dynamicContext);
885          }
886        }
887      }
888    }
889  }
890
891  private void validateKeyRef(
892      @NonNull IIndexHasKeyConstraint constraint,
893      @NonNull INodeItem contextNode,
894      @NonNull INodeItem item,
895      @NonNull String indexName,
896      @Nullable IIndex index,
897      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
898    IConstraintValidationHandler handler = getConstraintValidationHandler();
899    try {
900      List<String> key;
901      try {
902        key = IIndex.toKey(item, constraint.getKeyFields(), dynamicContext);
903      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
904        handler.handleError(constraint, item, toErrorMessage(constraint, item, ex), ex, dynamicContext);
905        throw ex;
906      }
907
908      if (index == null) {
909        handler.handleMissingIndexViolation(
910            constraint,
911            contextNode,
912            item,
913            ObjectUtils.notNull(String.format("Key reference to undefined index with name '%s'",
914                indexName)),
915            dynamicContext);
916      } else {
917        INodeItem referencedItem = index.get(key);
918
919        if (referencedItem == null) {
920          handler.handleIndexMiss(constraint, contextNode, item, key, dynamicContext);
921        } else {
922          handlePass(constraint, contextNode, item, dynamicContext);
923        }
924      }
925    } catch (MetapathException ex) {
926      handler.handleKeyMatchError(constraint, contextNode, item, ex, dynamicContext);
927    }
928  }
929
930  private class ValueStatus {
931    @NonNull
932    private final List<Pair<IAllowedValuesConstraint, IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>>> constraints = new LinkedList<>();
933    @NonNull
934    private final String value;
935    @NonNull
936    private final INodeItem item;
937    private boolean allowOthers = true;
938    @NonNull
939    private IAllowedValuesConstraint.Extensible extensible = IAllowedValuesConstraint.Extensible.EXTERNAL;
940
941    public ValueStatus(@NonNull INodeItem item) {
942      this.item = item;
943      this.value = item.toAtomicItem().asString();
944    }
945
946    public void registerAllowedValues(
947        @NonNull IAllowedValuesConstraint allowedValues,
948        @NonNull IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?> node) throws ConstraintValidationException {
949      IAllowedValuesConstraint.Extensible newExtensible = allowedValues.getExtensible();
950      if (newExtensible.ordinal() > extensible.ordinal()) {
951        // record the most restrictive value
952        extensible = allowedValues.getExtensible();
953      } else if (newExtensible == IAllowedValuesConstraint.Extensible.NONE
954          && extensible == IAllowedValuesConstraint.Extensible.NONE) {
955        // this is an error, where there are two none constraints that conflict
956        // TODO: find a different exception type to use
957        throw new ConstraintValidationException(
958            ObjectUtils.notNull(String.format(
959                "Multiple constraints matching path '%s' have scope='none', which prevents extension. Involved" +
960                    " constraints are: %s",
961                Stream.concat(
962                    Stream.of(allowedValues),
963                    constraints.stream()
964                        .map(Pair::getLeft)
965                        .filter(
966                            constraint -> constraint.getExtensible() == IAllowedValuesConstraint.Extensible.NONE))
967                    .map(IConstraint::getConstraintIdentity)
968                    .collect(Collectors.joining(", ", "{", "}")),
969                item.getMetapath())));
970      } else if (allowedValues.getExtensible().ordinal() < extensible.ordinal()) {
971        String msg = ObjectUtils.notNull(String.format(
972            "An allowed values constraint with an extensibility scope '%s'"
973                + " exceeds the allowed scope '%s' at path '%s'",
974            allowedValues.getExtensible().name(), extensible.name(), item.getMetapath()));
975        LOGGER.atError().log(msg);
976        throw new ConstraintValidationException(msg);
977      }
978      this.constraints.add(Pair.of(allowedValues, node));
979      if (!allowedValues.isAllowedOther()) {
980        // record the most restrictive value
981        allowOthers = false;
982      }
983    }
984
985    public void validate(@NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
986      if (!constraints.isEmpty()) {
987        boolean match = false;
988        List<IAllowedValuesConstraint> failedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
989        IConstraintValidationHandler handler = getConstraintValidationHandler();
990        for (Pair<IAllowedValuesConstraint, IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> pair : constraints) {
991          IAllowedValuesConstraint allowedValues = pair.getLeft();
992          IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?> node = ObjectUtils.notNull(pair.getRight());
993          IAllowedValue matchingValue = allowedValues.getAllowedValue(value);
994          if (matchingValue != null) {
995            match = true;
996            handlePass(allowedValues, node, item, dynamicContext);
997          } else if (allowedValues.getExtensible() == IAllowedValuesConstraint.Extensible.NONE) {
998            // hard failure, since no other values can satisfy this constraint
999            failedConstraints = CollectionUtil.singletonList(allowedValues);
1000            match = false;
1001            break;
1002          } else {
1003            failedConstraints.add(allowedValues);
1004          } // this constraint passes, but we need to make sure other constraints do as well
1005        }
1006
1007        // it's not a failure if allow others is true
1008        if (!match && !allowOthers) {
1009          handler.handleAllowedValuesViolation(failedConstraints, item, dynamicContext);
1010        }
1011      }
1012    }
1013  }
1014
1015  class Visitor
1016      extends AbstractNodeItemVisitor<DynamicContext, Void> {
1017
1018    @NonNull
1019    private DynamicContext handleLetStatements(
1020        @NonNull INodeItem focus,
1021        @NonNull Map<IEnhancedQName, ILet> letExpressions,
1022        @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
1023
1024      DynamicContext retval;
1025      Collection<ILet> lets = letExpressions.values();
1026      if (lets.isEmpty()) {
1027        retval = dynamicContext;
1028      } else {
1029        final DynamicContext subContext = dynamicContext.subContext();
1030
1031        for (ILet let : lets) {
1032          IEnhancedQName name = let.getName();
1033          ISequence<?> result = let.getValueExpression().evaluate(focus, subContext);
1034          subContext.bindVariableValue(
1035              name,
1036              // ensure the sequence is list backed
1037              result.reusable());
1038        }
1039        retval = subContext;
1040      }
1041      return retval;
1042    }
1043
1044    @Override
1045    public Void visitFlag(@NonNull IFlagNodeItem item, DynamicContext context) {
1046      assert context != null;
1047
1048      IFlagDefinition definition = item.getDefinition();
1049      DynamicContext effectiveContext = handleLetStatements(item, definition.getLetExpressions(), context);
1050
1051      validateFlag(item, effectiveContext);
1052      super.visitFlag(item, effectiveContext);
1053      handleAllowedValues(item, context);
1054      return null;
1055    }
1056
1057    @Override
1058    public Void visitField(@NonNull IFieldNodeItem item, DynamicContext context) {
1059      assert context != null;
1060
1061      IFieldDefinition definition = item.getDefinition();
1062      DynamicContext effectiveContext = handleLetStatements(item, definition.getLetExpressions(), context);
1063
1064      validateField(item, effectiveContext);
1065      super.visitField(item, effectiveContext);
1066      handleAllowedValues(item, context);
1067      return null;
1068    }
1069
1070    @Override
1071    public Void visitAssembly(@NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem item, DynamicContext context) {
1072      assert context != null;
1073
1074      IAssemblyDefinition definition = item.getDefinition();
1075      DynamicContext effectiveContext = handleLetStatements(item, definition.getLetExpressions(), context);
1076
1077      try {
1078        validateAssembly(item, effectiveContext);
1079      } catch (ConstraintValidationException ex) {
1080        throw ExceptionUtils.wrap(ex);
1081      }
1082      super.visitAssembly(item, effectiveContext);
1083      return null;
1084    }
1085
1086    @Override
1087    public Void visitMetaschema(@NonNull IModuleNodeItem item, DynamicContext context) {
1088      throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Method not used.");
1089    }
1090
1091    @Override
1092    protected Void defaultResult() {
1093      // no result value
1094      return null;
1095    }
1096  }

1106    public KeyRef(
1107        @NonNull IIndexHasKeyConstraint constraint,

1112      this.targets = targets;

1115    @NonNull
1116    public IIndexHasKeyConstraint getConstraint() {

1118    }
1119
1120    @NonNull
1121    protected INodeItem getNode() {
1122      return node;
1123    }
1124
1125    @NonNull
1126    public List<INodeItem> getTargets() {
1127      return targets;
1128    }
1129  }
